items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: you lead a small touring band with vocalist (inaudible) Harris and Larry Darnelle.

ctx.x: No, we just did the last few things he had. The rest of it he had done. But I had to show him, so that show was really going over.
